description:
Carrying the blood of a celestial, an Aasimar is usually good-aligned and fights
against evil in the world.

feats.description:
You gain a racial lay on hands SLA which heals for 10 + Character Level * Wisdom Modifier.
+2 Racial bonus to Heal, Listen and Spot.
+5 Resistance to Cold, Acid and Electricity
feats.name: Aasimar Racial Traits

feats.description: While fallen stance is active you gain +1 Strength and +1 to Reflex saving throws.
feats.name: Aasimar: Fallen Bond

feats.description: While protector stance is active you gain +1 Charisma and +1 to Will saving throws.
feats.name: Aasimar: Protector Bond

name: Aasimar
